issues.title: feat: add standalone artifact update notice
clipboardExcerpt: Forwarded standalone Archify HTML can show its generator version but had no explicit, bounded way for a reader to discover a newer stable version. This PR adds a quiet update notice to Native Viewer and Explainer artifacts. Both remain offline-first: no polling, telemetry, persistence, credentials, or automatic installation is introduced.
- Keep the readers aligned: Native Viewer and Explainer use the same externally observable update contract.

Current head `a7552e53490d544eac1be1951a0484e89b501710` includes the bounded streaming-manifest regression tests. The generated gallery, checkout comparison, README proof receipt, and skill archive were refreshed on the preceding generated-output commit; the final test-only commit does not alter generated sources or delivery artifacts. Standalone Explainer pages no longer serialize the private author `inputPath`.
- Earlier generated-output validation: checkout comparison, gallery, README motion proof, both Explainer private-path tests, `npm run test:core` (19/19), and `npm run test:generated` passed.

feat(explainer): improve visual hierarchy, KPI deltas, code focus, and interactive details
clipboardExcerpt: Enhance Archify Explainer visual hierarchy, information density, and interactive comprehension across the schema, parser, validator, renderer, reader runtime/styles, and showcase artifacts:
- Add directional dashed stroke-dashoffset flow animation (`@keyframes explainer-edge-flow`) on highlighted SVG edges and enforce readable SVG label sizes (`>=12.5px`).
- Support `before=<number>` on `@metric` in `explainer.schema.json` and `parse.mjs` to render baseline-to-current comparisons (`80 ms → 600 ms`, `×7.5` / `+10%`).
- Enrich `docs/cases/explainer/*.archify.md` and re-render all four showcase pages (`p99-tail-latency.html`, `finalize-delivery.html`, `tls-first-visit.html`, `first-rental.html`).
